## Who is Sai Karun Nandipati?

Sai Karun Nandipati is an Assistant Professor and AI Architect based in India who researches and teaches Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and fullstack systems. He currently serves at PB Siddhartha College of Arts and Science in the Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, and previously taught at KBN College.

His research focuses on Agentic AI, Human-AI Symbiosis, multi-agent systems, digital twins, and AI in education. He thinks of his work as "my words are prompts to AI systems, lessons to students, and code for the future."

## What does Sai Karun Nandipati do?

1. **Research**: Agentic AI, multi-agent swarm intelligence, generative models, and Human-AI Symbiosis.
2. **Teaching**: Assistant Professor teaching Generative AI, Big Data Analytics, and fullstack engineering; mentoring the next generation of developers.
3. **Authoring**: 30+ published books and book chapters on AI, including agentic systems, prompt engineering, RAG, and generative AI.
4. **Engineering**: Open-source systems and EdTech platforms spanning multi-agent orchestration, AI content management, and learning tools.
5. **Services**: Research assistance, online tutoring via NRCM Tutorials, technical writing, and AI literacy education.

## Services Offered

2. **Online Tutoring (NRCM Tutorials)**: 1-on-1 mentorship, interactive course modules, hands-on coding projects, and interview preparation for Machine Learning, Web Development, and AI Literacy.
3. **Technical Writing**: White papers, journals, API documentation, technical blog writing, and case studies.

## Key Projects

### S-AI — Multi-Agent Swarm Intelligence
A published npm multi-agent swarm system with neural Digital Twin persona adaptation, arXiv research mapping, Bhashini multilingual AI, MCP integration, and bias-reduced consensus across 6 specialized agents. TypeScript, LLM, Agentic, Open Source. Available at https://www.npmjs.com/package/@saikarun/s-ai

### S-AI Update — Synthetic Executive
S-AI v6.1: Synthetic Executive with security hardening, SSRF protection, sandboxing, and TRL/MRL/IRL readiness.

### Collabuild — Research-to-Prototype Pipeline
A multi-agent system implementation that turns research papers into working prototypes through an automated orchestrated pipeline of specialized research agents. Python, Multi-Agent, Docker.

### Duet AI Ecosystem
An Agentic AI ecosystem investigating the fundamental process of Human-Computer Interaction and Parallel Consciousness through prompt architecture. Python, LLM, Agentic.

### AppIdea — Privacy-First Product Workspace
A client-side workspace that turns raw ideas into professional documents (Charter, PRD, TDD, Pitch Deck) with AES-256 encrypted, locally stored data.

### LeadGen Agent
A multi-agent lead generation system that validates, enriches, and scores leads using OCR document parsing, Bhashini AI, and web intelligence.

### EdTech Tools
Prompt-Code (prompt engineering arena), Tut-Hub (LMS), Study Buddy Next (AI study companion), AI-CMS (content management), and Career Roadmap Generator.
